How did researchers use Cognitive Memory Streams to achieve a 92% leap in retrieval accuracy?
Does Cognitive Memory Streams actually outperform standard vector retrieval by 92%, or is it just hype?
Why does standard vector search break down when summarizing an entire corpus? Enter Cognitive Memory Streams.
Why should engineers care about Cognitive Memory Streams? Because sticking agents in a sandbox without persistent memory turns your LLM into a goldfish with infinite amnesia.

Everyone thought standard methods were enough, until Cognitive Memory Streams proved: in this paper, we introduce generative agents--computational software agents that simulate believable human behavior.

Why is Cognitive Memory Streams a major breakthrough? Because believable proxies of human behavior can empower interactive applications ranging from immersive environments to rehearsal spaces for interpersonal communication to prototyping tools.
